CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnBeginPlay
CodeBlockMethod.Code:
self.panelRoot.Enable = false self.noticeLabel.Enable = false self.waitIcon1.Enable = false self.waitIcon2.Enable = false self.waitIconConfirm.Enable = false
self.sliderBgmHandler = self.sliderBgm.Entity:ConnectEvent(SliderValueChangedEvent, self.OnBgmChanged) self.sliderSfxHandler = self.sliderSfx.Entity:ConnectEvent(SliderValueChangedEvent, self.OnSfxChanged) self.sliderSfxTouchHandler = self.sliderSfxTouch.Entity:ConnectEvent(UITouchEndDragEvent, self.OnSfxReleased) self.btnChange1Handler = self.btnChange1.Entity:ConnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.OnChange1Click) self.btnChange2Handler = self.btnChange2.Entity:ConnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.OnChange2Click) self.btnChangeConfirmHandler = self.btnChangeConfirm.Entity:ConnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.OnChangeConfirmClick) self.btnRevertKeysHandler = self.btnRevertKeys.Entity:ConnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.OnRevertKeysClick) self.btnSyncAdjustHandler = self.btnSyncAdjust.Entity:ConnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.OnSyncAdjustClick) self.btnApplyHandler = self.btnApply.Entity:ConnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.OnApplyClick) self.btnCloseHandler = self.btnClose.Entity:ConnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.OnCloseClick) self.keyDownHandler = _InputService:ConnectEvent(KeyDownEvent, self.OnGlobalKeyDown)
log("[SettingsPanelLogic] OnBeginPlay wired")

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnEndPlay
CodeBlockMethod.Code: if self.sliderBgmHandler then self.sliderBgm.Entity:DisconnectEvent(SliderValueChangedEvent, self.sliderBgmHandler) end if self.sliderSfxHandler then self.sliderSfx.Entity:DisconnectEvent(SliderValueChangedEvent, self.sliderSfxHandler) end if self.sliderSfxTouchHandler then self.sliderSfxTouch.Entity:DisconnectEvent(UITouchEndDragEvent, self.sliderSfxTouchHandler) end if self.btnChange1Handler then self.btnChange1.Entity:DisconnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.btnChange1Handler) end if self.btnChange2Handler then self.btnChange2.Entity:DisconnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.btnChange2Handler) end if self.btnChangeConfirmHandler then self.btnChangeConfirm.Entity:DisconnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.btnChangeConfirmHandler) end if self.btnRevertKeysHandler then self.btnRevertKeys.Entity:DisconnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.btnRevertKeysHandler) end if self.btnSyncAdjustHandler then self.btnSyncAdjust.Entity:DisconnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.btnSyncAdjustHandler) end if self.btnApplyHandler then self.btnApply.Entity:DisconnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.btnApplyHandler) end if self.btnCloseHandler then self.btnClose.Entity:DisconnectEvent(ButtonClickEvent, self.btnCloseHandler) end if self.keyDownHandler then _InputService:DisconnectEvent(KeyDownEvent, self.keyDownHandler) end if self.noticeTimerId ~= 0 then _TimerService:ClearTimer(self.noticeTimerId) end

CodeBlockMethod.Name: Open
CodeBlockMethod.Code: -- 외부(예: HUD 설정 버튼)에서 _SettingsPanelLogic:Open() 으로 호출합니다. if self.isOpen then return end self.isOpen = true if self.pauseWhileOpen then _PauseManager:RequestPause(self.pauseReasonId) end self:RefreshFromDraft() self.panelRoot.Enable = true

CodeBlockMethod.Name: Close
CodeBlockMethod.Code: if not self.isOpen then return end self:CancelRebind() -- 저장하지 않고 닫으므로 볼륨 프리뷰까지 마지막 저장값으로 롤백합니다. _SettingsManager:DiscardDraft() self.isOpen = false self:HideNotice() self.panelRoot.Enable = false if self.pauseWhileOpen then _PauseManager:RequestResume(self.pauseReasonId) end

CodeBlockMethod.Name: RefreshFromDraft
CodeBlockMethod.Code: local draft = _SettingsManager:GetDraft() self.sliderBgm.Value = draft.volume.bgm self.valueBgm.Text = tostring(draft.volume.bgm) self.sliderSfx.Value = draft.volume.sfx self.valueSfx.Text = tostring(draft.volume.sfx) self.keyText1.Text = _SettingsManager:DisplayOf(draft.keys.Input1) self.keyText2.Text = _SettingsManager:DisplayOf(draft.keys.Input2) self.keyTextConfirm.Text = _SettingsManager:DisplayOf(draft.keys.Confirm) self.syncValueText.Text = self:FormatSync(draft.syncOffsetMs)

CodeBlockMethod.Name: FormatSync
CodeBlockMethod.Code: if ms > 0 then return "+" .. tostring(ms) .. "ms" end return tostring(ms) .. "ms"

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnBgmChanged
CodeBlockMethod.Code: local v = math.floor(event.Value + 0.5) _SettingsManager:SetDraftVolume("bgm", v) self.valueBgm.Text = tostring(v) -- 드래그 중 바로 들리게 하되, 확정은 "적용하기"에서 합니다. _SoundManager:SetBgmVolume(v)

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnSfxChanged
CodeBlockMethod.Code: local v = math.floor(event.Value + 0.5) _SettingsManager:SetDraftVolume("sfx", v) self.valueSfx.Text = tostring(v) _SoundManager:SetSfxVolume(v)

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnSfxReleased
CodeBlockMethod.Code: -- 값 변경 이벤트에 미리듣기를 걸면 드래그 중 초당 수십 번 재생되므로, -- 손을 놓는 순간에만 1회 재생합니다. _SoundManager:PreviewSfx()

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnChange1Click
CodeBlockMethod.Code: self:BeginRebind("Input1")

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnChange2Click
CodeBlockMethod.Code: self:BeginRebind("Input2")

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnChangeConfirmClick
CodeBlockMethod.Code: self:BeginRebind("Confirm")

CodeBlockMethod.Name: KeyTextOf
CodeBlockMethod.Code: if action == "Input1" then return self.keyText1 end if action == "Input2" then return self.keyText2 end if action == "Confirm" then return self.keyTextConfirm end return nil

CodeBlockMethod.Name: WaitIconOf
CodeBlockMethod.Code: if action == "Input1" then return self.waitIcon1 end if action == "Input2" then return self.waitIcon2 end if action == "Confirm" then return self.waitIconConfirm end return nil

CodeBlockMethod.Name: BeginRebind
CodeBlockMethod.Code:
-- 한 번에 하나의 행만 입력 대기 상태일 수 있습니다. if self.waitingAction ~= "" then self:CancelRebind() end self.waitingAction = action
local textComponent = self:KeyTextOf(action) if isvalid(textComponent) then textComponent.Text = self.waitingLabel end local icon = self:WaitIconOf(action) if isvalid(icon) then icon.Enable = true end self:ShowNotice("변경할 키를 누르세요. (ESC: 취소)")

CodeBlockMethod.Name: CancelRebind
CodeBlockMethod.Code: if self.waitingAction == "" then return end local icon = self:WaitIconOf(self.waitingAction) if isvalid(icon) then icon.Enable = false end self.waitingAction = "" -- draft 값으로 다시 그려서 "입력 대기" 표시를 원래 키로 되돌립니다. self:RefreshFromDraft()

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnGlobalKeyDown
CodeBlockMethod.Code:
local keyName = _SettingsManager:KeyNameFromCode(event.key)
if self.waitingAction ~= "" then if keyName == "Escape" then self:CancelRebind() self:ShowNotice("키 변경을 취소했습니다.") return end if keyName == "" then self:ShowNotice("인식할 수 없는 키입니다.") return end if _SettingsManager:IsForbiddenKey(keyName) then self:ShowNotice("이 키는 사용할 수 없습니다.") return end
local owner = _SettingsManager:FindDraftActionByKey(keyName) if owner ~= "" and owner ~= self.waitingAction then self:ShowNotice("이미 사용 중인 키입니다.") self:CancelRebind() return end
local action = self.waitingAction _SettingsManager:SetDraftKey(action, keyName) local icon = self:WaitIconOf(action) if isvalid(icon) then icon.Enable = false end self.waitingAction = "" self:RefreshFromDraft() self:ShowNotice("변경되었습니다. 적용하기를 눌러 저장하세요.") return end
if keyName == "Escape" and self.isOpen then self:Close() end

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnRevertKeysClick
CodeBlockMethod.Code: self:CancelRebind() _SettingsManager:ResetDraftKeys() self:RefreshFromDraft() self:ShowNotice("키 설정을 기본값으로 되돌렸습니다.")

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnSyncAdjustClick
CodeBlockMethod.Code: -- TODO: 원래 "조절하기"는 비트에 맞춰 입력을 받아 오프셋을 계산하는 -- 별도의 싱크 보정 화면을 여는 버튼입니다. 그 화면이 아직 없어, -- 값을 직접 확인할 수 있도록 클릭할 때마다 syncStepMs 만큼 올리고 -- 상한을 넘으면 하한으로 돌아가는 임시 동작을 넣어 두었습니다. local draft = _SettingsManager:GetDraft() local nextValue = draft.syncOffsetMs + self.syncStepMs if nextValue > self.syncMaxMs then nextValue = self.syncMinMs end _SettingsManager:SetDraftSyncOffset(nextValue) self:RefreshFromDraft()

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnApplyClick
CodeBlockMethod.Code: self:CancelRebind() if not _SettingsManager:IsDirty() then self:ShowNotice("변경된 내용이 없습니다.") return end _SettingsManager:ApplyDraft() self:ShowNotice("설정을 저장했습니다.")

CodeBlockMethod.Name: OnCloseClick
CodeBlockMethod.Code: self:Close()

CodeBlockMethod.Name: ShowNotice
CodeBlockMethod.Code:
self.noticeText.Text = message self.noticeLabel.Enable = true
if self.noticeTimerId ~= 0 then _TimerService:ClearTimer(self.noticeTimerId) self.noticeTimerId = 0 end -- 한 번만 실행되면 되므로 첫 발화에서 스스로 타이머를 정리합니다. self.noticeTimerId = _TimerService:SetTimerRepeat(function() if self.noticeTimerId ~= 0 then _TimerService:ClearTimer(self.noticeTimerId) self.noticeTimerId = 0 end self:HideNotice() end, self.noticeDurationSeconds)

CodeBlockMethod.Name: HideNotice
CodeBlockMethod.Code: self.noticeLabel.Enable = false
